note: the reflected gradient is not mirrored at a, so pixels behind a clamp to 0 instead of repeating the ramp, caught by RasterGradientTests.reflectedMirrors
the angle gradient measures from the x axis not from the direction a to b, so angle 0 points along +x whatever b is, caught by RasterGradientTests.angleStartsAtB
anchor: let turn = (atan2(dy, dx) - atan2(vy, vx)) / (2 * Double.pi)

note: the ramp's t is not clamped to the last stop, so past b the colour extrapolates beyond its last stop, caught by RasterGradientTests.clampsPastEnd
replacement: guard t < offsets[last] else { return (last - 1, t) }

note: the gradient stop limit is half-open, so a valid 64-stop gradient throws, caught by RasterGradientTests.sixtyFourStopsAccepted
the stop ramp's hard edge takes the earlier stop, so a t exactly on two equal offsets gets the first colour, caught by RasterGradientTests.hardEdgeTakesLaterStopInGradientAndMap
the gradient's tabulated ramp drops its lerp between samples, so t is quantised to 1/256 steps, caught by RasterGradientTests.shapesMatchAnalyticT
anchor: let u = f * Double(Self.samples), i = min(Int(u), Self.samples - 1), w = u - Double(i)
replacement: let u = f * Double(Self.samples), i = min(Int(u), Self.samples - 1), w = 0.0

note: the gradient dithers its premultiplied colour, not the straight one, so a semi-transparent dithered pixel comes out as RGB times alpha squared, caught by GradientDitherTests.semiTransparentKeepsStraightColour
anchor: let shown = dither ? GradientDither.dithered(straight, x: x, y: y) : straight
replacement: let shown = dither ? GradientDither.dithered(straight.premultiplied(), x: x, y: y) : straight

note: the linear projection drops the y term, so a vertical or diagonal drag ramps along x only, caught by RasterGradientTests.shapesFollowDiagonalDirection
anchor: let along = (dx * vx + dy * vy) / length2

note: perceptual stops are mixed as linear light, not in OKLab, caught by RasterGradientTests.stopsInterpolateInOKLab
anchor: ? try FillColor.converted(c, from: .linearSRGB, to: .oklab, what: "gradient stop colour \(c)") : c

note: the diamond gradient drops its cross axis and becomes a reflected ramp, caught by RasterGradientTests.shapesMatchAnalyticT
anchor: case .diamond: return max(abs(along), abs((vx * dy - vy * dx) / length2))
